description: This file defines a speech provider plugin for ElevenLabs TTS, including configuration normalization, directive parsing, voice listing, and synthesis functions.

methods.name: isValidVoiceId
methods.description: Validates if a voice ID matches the expected pattern.

methods.name: normalizeElevenLabsBaseUrl
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from the base URL or returns default.

methods.name: normalizeElevenLabsProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes raw configuration into structured ElevenLabsProviderConfig.

methods.name: readElevenLabsProviderConfig
methods.description: Reads and applies defaults to provider configuration.

methods.name: mergeVoiceSettingsOverride
methods.description: Merges voice settings overrides into current context.

methods.name: parseDirectiveToken
methods.description: Parses directive tokens for voice and normalization settings.

methods.name: listElevenLabsVoices
methods.description: Fetches list of available ElevenLabs voices via API.

methods.name: buildElevenLabsSpeechProvider
methods.description: Builds and returns the ElevenLabs speech provider plugin object.
